purpose: Apply finite spectral mathematics to actual BPD component masks and native recurrent-state Jacobians.
unit: independently initialized native miniature TRM; repeated transitions and component masks remain measurements within that initialization

model.state: complete pair (z_h,z_l), including the prefix position

design.walsh_response: the 44-coordinate final full-head logit-delta vector, covering four token positions and all eleven head rows; squared logit drift is recorded separately
design.primary_contrast: all-components retained versus the native target for implementation parity; numerical identities use every recorded mask and transition
design.physical_dose: record delivered write displacement and full-state displacement; the Boolean cube intentionally includes different doses
design.causal_controls: full mask target parity, zero component mask with retained residual, finite-difference JVP checks, and explicit local linearization remainder
design.planned_and_actual_comparisons: all 16 mask responses and all four ordered transitions are retained for every initialization; no winner-only reporting
design.scientific_variation_floor_reason: This packet tests instruments and mathematical identities. A future task-effect benchmark must register its own endpoint and meaningful effect.
design.matched_sham_floor_reason: The mask cube varies dose and is not a matched-sham causal contrast. The separate historical DT05 preflight is preserved in evidence/.
design.estimated_resolution_power: not estimated for a new mechanism claim
design.readout_selection_exposure: fully exposed engineering token fixture; the entire final full-head logit-delta vector is fixed as the response before execution

mathematical_checks.trace_series: Require q=|z|*||A||_infinity<1. Report raw z=1 eligibility separately from an explicitly damped local operator. Bound the omitted logarithm tail by d*q^(K+1)/((K+1)*(1-q)).
mathematical_checks.transport: Use chronological products of state-dependent Jacobians and rectangular inclusion maps. Preserve leakage and the nonlinear finite-displacement remainder.
mathematical_checks.walsh: Require a complete unique Boolean mask cube and uniform weighting. Verify Parseval and the energy omitted by degree truncation.
mathematical_checks.arithmetic: Floating-point diagnostics with declared tolerances; the analytic tail bound excludes rounding error. The nonautonomous extension has an algebraic derivation and numerical tests.

failure_rules: Reject nonfinite matrices, mismatched dimensions, incomplete mask cubes and duplicate mask identifiers.
Refuse a trace-series truncation certificate outside its explicit norm domain.
Fail checks when all-ones component masks do not recover target outputs within the declared tolerance.
Retain every engineering initialization and every mask outcome, including diagnostic failures.
Reject a receipt that changes its engineering evidence class or claims scientific readiness.
